item.title: protect_items_from_groom uses wrong field name 'groomedNotes' — groomed notes silently discarded
item.intent: Groomed notes written by groom agents must survive the protect_items_from_groom pass.
steps: Locate the jq merge in protect_items_from_groom (~line 3149): 'groomedNotes: (.groomedNotes // $orig[.id].groomedNotes)'
Confirm actual field name: backlog edit --groomed-notes writes '.groomingNotes', backlog show reads '.groomingNotes'
Change the field reference in protect_items_from_groom from 'groomedNotes' to 'groomingNotes' (both sides of the //)
Run shellcheck and verify no new warnings
acceptanceCriteria: After a groom session writes --groomed-notes, the notes appear in backlog show output after protect_items_from_groom runs
No spurious 'groomedNotes: null' field is added to items during protect run
shellcheck passes with zero new warnings
